Garden Notes
❧
Container gardening
Growing herbs in a sunny corner

Basil and parsley grow well in small containers. Choose a pot with drainage holes and fill it with loose soil. Water when the surface feels dry. Rotate the pot each week so the leaves receive even light. Trim a few leaves at a time for the kitchen.

Notes from the garden desk
